lazyParse(string) keeps the simdjson DOM native; the timed loop reads kind and tags via valueForKeyPath (tags materializes the array: the binding has no length accessor). Retained: null, the document lives in native memory the JS heap reading does not see. Under Node 22 the process dies with SIGSEGV (reproduced with a bare lazyParse() loop, cause not traced into the 2021 addon); runs on Bun and Deno
